title: First Results from KamLAND: Evidence for Reactor Anti-Neutrino Disappearance
excerpt: In an exposure of 162 ton·yr (145.1 days) the ratio of the number of observed inverse β-decay events to the expected number of events without disappearance is 0.611±0.085 (stat) ±0.041 (syst) for antineutrino energies > 3.4 MeV.
